posts.title: 048 - beautiful people
posts.description: 1 - i didn't know you were special quite from the start, but it was pretty close 2 - i think that we've both grown so much. we've seen so many version of each other. i'd love to see who we both become, i think it'll be beautiful. 3 - i often fall victim to feeling like i need to soften my words around people. i think we see eye to eye in a way i've never felt before. 1, 1 - you've got other things

posts.title: 046 - my journey with vibecoding and agentic ai
posts.description: part 1 check out these sponsored links. watch the same three videos on repeat in a loop. this album seems like your favourite, why not listen to it again. here are some things we think you might like. crawl through life clawing out dopamine in 30-second scraps. don't let yourself get bored, don't let yourself get hurt. there's no point in keeping yourself at anything other than the barest baseline
